title: Lexicon id aliases (open-greek-lexica 0.3.0)
description: aliases.json: every entry id that a published release had and this one does not, with the ids that replace it. A site redirects a retired id to its successors.

successors.description: current entry ids that replace it; empty when the entry was removed with no successor

reason.description: one line for readers: merged into, split into, removed because

retired_in.description: the tag of the first release without the id: a dataset release of the lexicon, a tag of its public repository (cunliffe-2027-01-02, lsj8-2027-01-02), or a lexica serving release (lexica-2027-01-02)
